fields.version: 2002 journal typeset version, C. R. Math. 335(8), 667–670
fields.read_scope: Complete four-page journal pinned and independently reconstructed; the separate nine-page arXiv v1 was also checked. The original oscillatory moment theorem survives the printed class. The full statistic needs the documented logarithmic-moment alternative and additive comparison.
fields.claim_verification_status: Whole-work Level 3 for the exact journal version. One version-scoped missing-hypothesis finding and a valid repair. Finite moments without RH.
fields.main_result: With real even f, smooth compact Fourier transform of strict radius sigma, m sigma/2<a and H=T^a, 0<a≤1, the oscillatory prime part has its finite Gaussian window for nonnegative unit-mass bandlimited w. The full statistic has the stated finite Gaussian moments if ∫f=0 or ∫w log^m(2+|u|)<infinity. The literal printed weight class alone is too broad.

additional_source_manifestation.scope: Complete comparison by both independent reviewers; promotion pinned to journal.
